{{Game Update}} {{For|the version of Bonzo spawned from [[The Watcher]]|Bonzo (Watcher)}} {{Quote|Gratz for making it this far, but I'm basically unbeatable.
I don't even need to fight, this is the life!
I can summon lots of Undead.
Check this out!|Bonzo}} {{Infobox/Mob |image = {{InfoboxGallery |image1 = Bonzo_(Phase_1).png|label1 = Phase 1 |image2 = Bonzo.png|label2 = Phase 2 }} |category = Boss |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |damage = 2,664-45,000 |health = 250,000-200,000,000 }} |mob_type = *{{mt|Humanoid}} (Phase 1) *{{mt|Undead}} (Phase 2) *{{mt|Arcane}} |mob_level = 221-756 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor I]] |description = {{gray|New Necromancer}}
Involved in the dark arts due to his parents' insistence. Originally worked as a Circus Clown. |id = BONZO_1, MASTER_BONZO_1 }} '''Bonzo''' is the {{mcat|b}} of [[Catacombs - Floor I]] of [[The Catacombs]] Dungeon. == Collection == Killing Bonzo levels up the Bonzo Collection. {{CollectionTable|Bonzo}} {{/Collection UI}} == The Fight == === First Phase === Bonzo will continually summon {{MobSprite|Undead (Bonzo);Undead}}s, and run around attacking players with wither skulls during his first phase. Bonzo holds the [[Dark Orb]] during the first phase. Bonzo has {{Stat|Health|250,000}} and will move on to the second phase once players have killed his first phase. === Second Phase === Bonzo revives during his second phase, healing himself back to his max health and gaining '''Default Attack''' and '''Balloon Barrage'''. === Arena === Bonzo's arena is open in the center but has 7 different short pillars close to the edges. It heavily resembles a Circus arena, and Bonzo's first phase can go on top of the pillars. In his second phase, Bonzo's Balloon Barrage attack can aim his balloons on top of the pillars, meaning the only way to defend yourself against the attack is to either dodge the balloons yourself or hide behind a pillar. [[File:Bonzo Arena.png|thumb|334x334px]] == Attacks == * '''Default Attack '''- Strikes the player in melee range for damage. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. * '''Wither Skull '''- Bonzo fires a Wither Skull at a player dealing {{Stat|Damage|1,598}}. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the first phase. **In Master Mode, Bonzo shoots Wither Skulls more quickly. * '''Bonzo's Balloon '''- Bonzo fires a balloon at a player, dealing {{Stat|Damage|1,598}} in normal mode and {{Stat|Damage|22,500}} in [[Master Mode]]. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. ** This move is identical to '''Wither Skull'''. **In Master Mode, he tends to shoot his balloons at an upward angle. * '''Balloon Barrage '''- Bonzo moves to the center of the arena before unleashing a barrage of balloons around him in all directions. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the second phase. * '''Summon Undead'''- Bonzo will summon some {{MobSprite|Undead (Bonzo);Undead}}s to attack the player. The Undeads only have {{Stat|Health|45,000}} and act like regular Zombies. ** Bonzo uses this attack only during the first phase. == Master Mode Changes == * Bonzo has {{Hp|200M}} and his Undeads have {{Hp|15M}}. * Bonzo spawns Undeads more frequently in his 1st phase. * The Wither Skull and Balloon attacks deal {{Stat|Damage|22,500}}. == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Bonzo}} == Drops == Killing '''Bonzo''' in both phase one and two directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 221-756 |coins = 552-1,890 |combat_xp = 1,657-5,670 |orbs = 663-2,268 }} Defeating him in phase two will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor I/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor I/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 221 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor I]] |health = 250,000 |damage = 2,664 |coins = 552 |combat_xp = 1,657 |orbs = 663 |id = BONZO_1 |level2 = 756 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor I|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor I]] |health2 = 200,000,000 |damage2 = 45,000 |coins2 = 1,890 |combat_xp2 = 5,670 |orbs2 = 2,268 |id2 = MASTER_BONZO_1 }} == Trivia == * Bonzo's second phase's design is based on the main antagonist Pennywise, the Dancing Clown from ''It. '' ** Bonzo's first phase's skin was a skin the admin Likaos had. * If every player in the dungeon has already completed Floor I before, or in Master Floor 1, he will just say "Oh I'm dead! Sike." when transitioning to phase two. * The music playing in the background of the boss fight is Superior Judgement from the Hypixel Noteblock Song Competition 2020. * Bonzo can reappear as a spirit [[The Watcher]] summons on the 3rd, 4th, and 5th Floor. * Bonzo's line "You fools! You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!" is a reference to Vizzini from ''The Princess Bride.'' * The item Bonzo holds in his first phase appears to be a [[Dark Orb]]. * Bonzo gets the most references by characters in the Catacombs. Every boss up to Floor 4, excluding [[The Professor]], has at least 1 thing to do with Bonzo. **[[The Watcher]] brings him back as an Undead. ** [[Scarf]] has a line that says "I can't believe Bonzo lost to someone so weak!" ** Some members of [[Thorn|Thorn's]] audience will say "Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo" or "Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget" * Bonzo had a optifine cape displaying the non-binary flag design. *When Bonzo is summoned as an Undead is defeated, it doesn't add to the collection. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Start |{{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: Gratz for making it this far, but I’m basically unbeatable. &4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: I don't even need to fight, this is the life! &4[BOSS] &cBonzo&f: I can summon lots of undead! {{Game Update}} {{About|the {{mcat|boss}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]]}} {{Infobox/Mob |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 1,000,000,000-1,400,000,000 |damage = 7,200-300,000 |defense = 2,100 (Master Mode) }} |category = Boss |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]] |mob_level = 739-1,094 |mob_type = {{MobType|Arcane}}
{{MobType|Wither}} |description = {{gray|The Wither Lords}}
Disciples of the Wither King. Inherited the Catacombs eons ago. Never defeated, feared by anything living AND dead. |id = NECRON_1, MASTER_NECRON_1 }} '''Necron''' is a {{mcat|boss}} along with [[Maxor]], [[Storm]] and [[Goldor]] of [[The Catacombs]] in [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]] and is a disciple of [[The Wither King]]. == Collection == Killing Necron and the other Withers increases the Necron collection. {{CollectionTable|Necron}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss fight == The boss fight is split into four phases. (Five phases in Master Mode.) There are four Wither Lords: Maxor, Storm, Goldor, and '''Necron'''. Each Wither will be a boss for a phase that must be killed individually for each phase. Necron has {{Hp|1,000,000,000}} or {{Hp|1,400,000,000}} in Master Mode. He sometimes has a shield surrounding him, which protects him from all attacks. In all parts of the boss fight, lava damages the player for 20% of their max health, as well as launching them upwards in one of 2 ways: * '''Regular''': You are launched into the air at a standard height ({{InfoNeeded}} blocks). * '''Super''': Looking upwards at a pitch of -40 or lower triggers a Super lava bounce, boosting you 30% higher than a Regular jump. === Phase 1 === {{Main|Maxor#Boss Fight}} === Phase 2 === {{Main|Storm#Boss Fight}} === Phase 3 === {{Main|Goldor#Boss Fight}} === Phase 4 === The trapdoor in the core entrance will open after Goldor is defeated. As the players are about to reach the bottom layer of the factory, Necron hovers the players in the air over a platform surrounded by a ring of lava when he gives his welcome speech. He destroys the platform beneath the players and releases them into the lava. At {{stat|hp|80%}}, he will teleport to the center platform, blind the players, and begin a frenzy attack, dealing even more damage. The radius of this frenzy increases over time and decreases with the damage dealt. When it reaches 0, Necron will destroy a section of the outer ring and then resume attacking the players. This takes 10 seconds. This repeats at {{Stat|health|5%}}. The fight finishes when Necron reaches 0 {{Stat|health}}. Necron has several attacks. *Summoning a barrage of wither skulls launched from each of his three heads. They do high {{Stat|damage}} and are fired rapidly, dealing high knockback. **Necron will sometimes stay still and fire wither skulls at a much faster rate. *He enters a frenzy where explosions are centered on him, dealing extremely high amounts of damage to any player who gets close. The size of the explosions will increase while Necron is not being damaged and decrease when Necron is. *Shooting fireballs at players. *Causing lightning to strike nearby. *Summoning four floating Diamond Swords and launching them towards players, dealing {{Stat|dmg}} and knockback. *He flies into the air and summons four horizontal groups of beams, rotating around Necron for {{Green|15s}}. They deal {{Green|25%}} of the player's {{Stat|health}} in {{Stat|tdmg}} on contact. === Phase 5 (Master Mode Only) === {{Main|Wither King#Boss Fight}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" | When Phase 4 starts
(If the player has not defeated Necron before) | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: Finally, I heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: You went further than any human before, congratulations. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: I'm afraid, your journey ends now. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: My master and I spent centuries building this factory...and this army. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: I won't allow you to destroy it all now. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: Goodbye.}} |- | class="ct" | When Phase 4 starts
(If the player has defeated Necron before) | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: You went further than any human before, congratulations. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: I'm afraid, your journey ends now. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: Goodbye.}} |- | class="ct" | After the first platform is destroyed | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: That's a very impressive trick. I guess I'll have to handle this myself.}} |- | class="ct" | While attacking with Swords | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: I ensure you, these blades are far sharper than Goldor's ever were.}} |- | class="ct" | When killed | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: All this, for nothing... &4[BOSS] Necron&c: I understand your words now, my master. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: The Catacombs... are no more.}} |- | class="ct" | If all players die | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: FINALLY! This took way too long. &4[BOSS] Necron&c: Now that you're a Ghost, can you help me clean up?}} |- ! Condition ! Random Dialogue |- | rowspan="6" class="ct" | None | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: You merely adopted the Catacombs! I was molded by them!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: I - Necron - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: The Catacombs made you stronger, but can you beat me?!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: Show me how you beat Storm!!!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: Not just your Village, but the whole world will end!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: Fight for your life!}} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Before entering frenzy | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: WITNESS MY RAW NUCLEAR POWER!}} |- | rowspan="3" class="ct" | While in frenzy | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM}} |- | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: HASTA LA VISTA, BABY!}} |- | rowspan="1" class="ct" | When frenzy fails | {{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] Necron&c: ARGH!}} |} == Tips == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#The Wither Lords}} == Lore == *Necron, similarly to other inhabitants of [[The Catacombs|{{red|The Catacombs}}]], was a human. After being orphaned by the [[Calamity|{{darkRed|Calamity}}]], Necron sought to discover what magic killed his parents. That is why he joined the Mage's Academy. Unfortunately, he was not very good; he was even called "the worst student," despite being one of the oldest students at 17 years old. He desperately tried gaining access to Scrolls with forbidden magic, knowing that they were the answer to his problems, but his requests were always denied. *Ten days before the mage exam that Necron, with his current knowledge, did not have a chance to pass, he sat in his room, unable to sleep. He cursed the dean of the association for restricting his access to knowledge when he suddenly heard a subtle noise - a rustle of paper. Someone has slid some paper below his door. He could not believe what he saw, he quickly opened the door - but there was nobody there. Necron was holding a scroll with forbidden magic. He did not keep his interest in them a secret, but the scrolls were protected with advanced spells. Stealing them was unthinkable to anyone. He started learning the spell on the scroll. The scroll was able to make him invisible to regular magic. This spell would make him immune to vision spells and able to bypass weaker barriers - he thought of only one place where that would be useful, and he had no intention of going there. *Over a couple of days, he mastered the spell and thought of an almost too-perfect way to use it. He knew that for over a decade after his defeat, [[The Wither King]] was imprisoned in [[Wilderness#Broken_Cage|a cage]]. He was guarded by mages and a barrier, but the guards preferred to stay away from the cage itself. Necron pretended to help the guards with their chores. Despite his immense stress, he cast the spell in the forest, walked to the barrier, and crossed it without problems. As he approached the cage behind the barrier, he noticed the ground and everything around him being corrupted, losing its color. He saw it, a wither creature, about twice his size. He did it. He met Kaeman, The Wither King. *Only the middle of his heads seemed to notice him; "You are using my spell," the Wither said. He was surprised to hear the voice, and he heard it again. "Who are you, and why are you here?" it said. "Why am I here?" Necron finally answered, "My name is Necron. You killed my parents 17 years ago…" After a brief silence, The Wither King responded, "Is that why you are here, Necron?" "No..." Necron answered. He proceeded to question Kaeman about him, and the [[Fel Magic]] Dungeon Journal, The Apprentice Part 3 "You said I was using your spell, what do you mean?" asked Necron. "Fel magic, or a variant. I created that spell, and wrote the scroll myself." "So the rumors are true, you were a human before, called Kaeman?" "That is correct." "Fel magic… What is it, and why do I have an affinity for it? Have you done anything to me?" "I haven't. Well, at least not intentionally. I've never met anyone with an affinity for Fel magic, it is quite interesting." The Wither King continued: "While I didn't invent that kind of magic, I was the first human to study it, directly from the Dragon's heart. But the Academy was against any kind of progress for the dark arts, they have their own agenda." Apart from their common negative opinion of the Mage's Academy, they found more similarities within each other. Kaeman offered to teach Necron the basics of Dark Magic. Necron quickly lost interest in revenge against Kaeman. *Sometime later, Kaeman wanted something in return for being Necron's master. He wished to escape. They grew close, so Necron did not hesitate. Kaeman prepared a spell, and it was time. While it only lasted a few seconds, it was the most complicated thing Necron ever had to conjure. After the barrier was destabilized, Kaeman broke his cage and a part of the island, then jumped to the Void together with Necron, stopping their fall after about 100 meters, entering an opening in the cliff, and sealing it immediately behind them. "Just what is… What is this place?" Necron explained. "The Catacombs," Kaeman replied. *Five years after the events of the Journals Apprentice, [[Journal#Apprentice, Part 1|Part 1]]; [[Journal#Apprentice, Part 2|Part 2]] and [[Journal#Apprentice, Part 3|Part 3]], Kaeman taught Necron some more until he became a powerful mage. One night, he went to [[Wilderness#Tavern|an Inn]] for an unknown reason, where a young murderer attempted on his life. Necron took [[Livid]]'s corpse to The Catacombs, but he was followed. From his follower, [[Lathrop]], he learned that the reason for following a stranger was his visions, which told Lathrop that following him to his master would make him meet his full potential. Necron took his follower with him, and not long after taking him to Kaeman, Lathrop became [[The Watcher]]. *After [[The Watcher]]'s transformation, he was asked by The Wither King to create a world where he would live his happy days again. After difficult and exhausting work, he succeeded. The Wither King secluded himself from The Catacombs, entrusted Necron to be in charge of The Catacombs, and put The Watcher in Necron's service. *After destroying the Expedition to the Catacombs and sending [[Storm]] to destroy the castle. He began questioning his desire for conquest. == Trivia == *'''Necron''' smote and killed [[The Professor]], as shown at the end of [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] boss fight. This was his first introduction and was released back when he was the final boss of Dungeons. *'''Necron''', [[Storm]], [[Goldor]] and {{NPCSprite|Dante}} are the only mobs who can destroy constructions. *Back when he was the boss on Floor 7 alone, he had most phases of any existing boss - 4. These phases now feature other Wither Lords. *One of his old quotes, "YOU MERELY ADOPTED [[The Catacombs|THE CATACOMBS]], I WAS MOLDED BY THEM!" is a reference from the film ''The Dark Knight Rises''. **This line is also used by {{NPCSprite|Paul}} when he is a candidate for the mayor election. *The "HASTA LA VISTA, BABY!" quote is a reference to ''The Terminator 2'' and its subsequent sequels, where the catchphrase is referenced. *The name '''Necron''' comes from the Ancient Greek word for "dead" or "the dead" - νεκρός (nekrós). In this context, however, it could be interpreted as “of death” or “corpse”. *[[Necron]] and [[The Watcher]] are similarly old, both orphaned by someone using [[Fel Magic]]. While The Watcher's parents were killed by [[The Calamity|{{Dark Red|The Calamity}}]], it is never specified whether Necron's were killed by it too, or by [[The Wither King]] using the same magic. *The description of {{Item|Sorrow}} implies that those who go through immense distress become Ghosts; however, neither he nor [[Kaeman]] did become Ghosts. *Necron's beam attack is closely similar to Broken Heart Radiation used by a {{MobSprite|Voidgloom Seraph}} {{stier|4}}, albeit without a debuff of decreased {{stat|vitality}}. *'''Necron''' is the only Wither Lord that is completely vulnerable to damage throughout his boss fight. '''Maxor''', '''Storm''', and '''Goldor''' will only become vulnerable when a certain variable is met. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|8,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|7,200|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|500,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|450,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|2026/July 20 |Nerfed the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|450,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|300,000|icononly=yes}}. |Nerfed the Greatsword {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Red|10x}} to {{Red|5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}}. |Changed the lightning {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Red|15%}} of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}} to {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}}. }} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|739-1,094}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.8|'''Necron''' first appears in [[The Professor]]'s boss fight. When his third phase is over, Necron smites him with lightning, killing him, then warns the player against going further.}} {{History|0.9.13|[[File:Necron.png|26px]] Added '''Necron'''.}} {{History|0.12.3|Replaced Necron in phases 1, 2, and 3 of the Floor VII boss fight with [[Maxor]], [[Storm]], and [[Goldor]].}} {{History|0.26.1 |Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|8,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|7,200|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|500,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|300,000|icononly=yes}}. |Nerfed the Greatsword {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Red|10x}} to {{Red|5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}}. |Changed the lightning {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Red|15%}} of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}} to {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}}. }} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|739-1,094}}.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} {{Nav/Lore}} [[Category:Mobs]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Dungeons]] [[Category:Catacombs]] [[Category:Dungeon Mobs]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]

[[Necromancy]] was always strong in his family. Says he once beat a Wither in a duel. Likes to brag. |id = SADAN_1, MASTER_SADAN_1 }} '''Sadan''' is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor VI]], and as a character appearing in the [[Journal Entry|dungeon journals]] [[Journal Entry#Aftermath|Aftermath]] and [[Journal Entry#The Eye|The Eye]]. His status is the '''Necromancer Lord'''. == Collection == Killing Sadan increases the Sadan collection. {{CollectionTable|Sadan}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == Sadan's boss fight takes place in a large, tall hall with two wings, one of which the players emerge from. When the players enter, 16 dormant {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s stand along the hall. {{MobSprite|Sleeping Golem}}s reside in the main chamber of Sadan's room, and attacking them will turn them into {{MobSprite|Woke Golem}}. Above are four cages, each with a Giant inside it, and a large section beneath containing a larger Giant. === Phase 1 === During Sadan's first phase, he reanimates several {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s that will start to damage the player, dealing melee and ranged damage. These will attack the players for {{Green|2}} minutes, displayed by a timer labeled '''Sadan's Interest Meter''': killing a {{MobSprite|Terracotta}} will reduce this timer by {{Green|1}} second. Once killed, {{MobSprite|Terracotta}}s will turn into a skull on the ground. After {{Green|10}} seconds, they will respawn where they died and attack the player until '''Sadan's Interest Meter''' is depleted. === Phase 2 === Four different giants, being {{MobSprite|The Diamond Giant}}, {{MobSprite|L.A.S.R.}}, {{MobSprite|Bigfoot}}, and the {{MobSprite|Jolly Pink Giant}}, will drop from cages in the sky to attack. Each giant has a different attack and has a chance to appear as [[The Watcher|Watcher Undeads]] in [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]]. * {{MobSprite|The Diamond Giant}} will damage players with the '''Sword of 1,000 Truths'''. * {{MobSprite|L.A.S.R.}} will fire at players with a the '''L.A.S.R Eye Beam''', dealing increased damage over time. * {{MobSprite|Bigfoot}} will use '''Stomp''' on players, dealing high amounts of damage. * The {{MobSprite|Jolly Pink Giant}} will use '''Boulder Toss''' on players, throwing a large boulder at players and dealing large damage. === Phase 3 === A cutscene will play where Sadan will merge with his "Ultimate Corpse", {{MobSprite|The Giant One|nolink=yes}}, and become a Giant himself. A hole will open in the center of the hall, and a hook will appear to lift the Giant out. Falling into the hole instantly kills the player who fell in and all [[Tank]]s in the team (because of [[Tank]]s' passive ability Diversion). After this cutscene, the hole closes, allowing players to safely walk over it again. In the form of The Giant One, Sadan has all the perks of the previous Giants combined. Players win the fight by defeating Sadan in this Giant form. Unlike the previous giants, The Giant One does not have [[Knockback]] immunity. === Summoned Mobs === Below are a list of [[Mobs]] that appear during the fight. In [[Master Mode]], the four giants are replaced with four {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s. {{Mob Table|show_behavior = yes| {{Mob Table Row|Terracotta|behavior = Attacks the player with the melee and ranged attacks of the {{Item|Flower of Truth}}. The ranged attack can pass through walls. It revives itself after a while on Phase 1.}} {{Mob Table Row|Golem|name = Sleeping/Woke Golem |behavior = This Golem awakes once it is attacked, after which it quickly runs towards nearby players to attack them.}} {{Mob Table Row|Bigfoot|behavior = Can stomp to deal very heavy damage. The damage depends how close the player is to the mob when the attack is performed and how high the mob jumped.}} {{Mob Table Row|L.A.S.R.|behavior = Shoots lasers that never miss at players.}} {{Mob Table Row|Jolly Pink Giant|behavior = Can toss boulders. Damage dealt depends on how close the player is to the center of the impact.}} {{Mob Table Row|The Diamond Giant|behavior = Can use the Sword of 10,000 Truths to deal heavy damage. The mob can also throw the sword to deal even more damage.}} {{Mob Table Row|Mutant Giant|behavior = Has two random abilities of the previous four giants.}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * Instead of the normal giants, {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s will spawn with {{Stat|Health|600,000,000}}, and can use all two randomly selected abilities of the other giants at once. * After the cutscene, the 4 {{MobSprite|Mutant Giant}}s respawn at the 4 pillars together with Sadan to fight the players. == Drops == Killing Sadan directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 611-1,097 |coins = 1,527-2,742 |combat_xp = 4,582-8,227 |orbs = 1,833-3,291 }} Defeating him will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor VI/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor VI/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 611 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] |health = 40,000,000 |damage = 30,960 |coins = 1,527 |combat_xp = 4,582 |orbs = 1,833 |id = SADAN_1 |level2 = 1,097 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor III|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor III]] |health2 = 600,000,000 |damage2 = 720,000 |coins2 = 2,742 |combat_xp2 = 8,227 |orbs2 = 3,291 |id2 = MASTER_SADAN_1 }} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Boss Fight Start |{{Dialogue|&4[BOSS] &cSadan&f: So you made it all the way here... THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE!! &4[BOSS] &cSadan&f: FATHER, FORGIVE ME!!!}} |} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Sadan}} == Lore == * In [[Time Systems#AE|1531 AE]], after zombies began leaving [[The Catacombs|{{red|The Catacombs}}]] a human king sent an expedition with 3 mages to investigate. Mages were the Royal Inscriptionist, who kept a four-volume journal about the expedition until his death, [[Solomon]] and [[Sadan]]. * During the expedition, Sadan noticed [[The Watcher|an Eye]] looking directly at him, but no one else seemed to notice it, so he kept it to himself, since it didn't seem hostile. It appeared 3 times throughout the first and second floor, then disappeared. However, on the third floor, he felt a different sensation: he sensed something coming even before more talented [[Solomon]]. Sadan managed to escape the massacre caused by [[Necron|the Wither]] that appeared and killed [[General Dan]], then he felt the familiar sensation of being watched. He pulled out his sword, asking "What do you want from me?", [[The Watcher]] came out of the shadows and questioned him "What are you? Why are you following me?" "Special." the loud noise echoed in Sadan's head. "I’m special? What do you mean?" "Your mind… Hard to read." "Read… My mind?" "Your name." "What, why do you want to know?" "Your parents, who are they?" "I… I never knew them, why are you asking this?!" It asked for [his] name again. As it got closer, [he] could feel its presence intensify. "GET OUT OF MY HEAD, I’LL KILL YOU!" Sadan felt weakened, and collapsed on the ground. "So your name is Sadan, I see..." *Some time after his interaction with the Watcher, he became Necromancer Lord and guarded the Sixth floor of Catacombs. He learned that his parents were powerful in Necromancy, which is why Watcher was interested in him. *In 1532 AE, he learned that his father was still alive, if you could call it that. He was a member of [[Necron]]'s Wither Army - [[Storm]]. But his father didn't care for him, which made Sadan angry, and he swore that he would develop a technique to surpass even a Wither with his own abilities. *According to [[Mort]]'s description of Sadan, he succeeded, but it is unclear if the Wither in question was [[Storm]], his unknown professor or a different Wither entirely. == Trivia == * The boss appears to have an egotistical and self-centered nature, possibly caused by his father, [[Storm]] not caring about him and him choosing power rather than humanity. He shares his ego with his father, and they both seem to make up with each other when faced with death, as their last words reference each other. * This boss used to be a part of the Expedition team as one of at least 3 mages. Because his family was skilled in Necromancy, [[The Watcher]] saw his potential to be a servant of Necron. In the journal Aftermath, it is said that Solomon (One of the mages on the Expedition team) was also pulled aside by Necron and executed by Storm for him to gain immense power his third wither head. * The sword that the Diamond Giant wields is actually called Diamante (which translates to "Diamond" in Spanish and Italian). * His head has the same texture as the [[The Professor|Professor's]], except recoloured. * The Terracotta mob is a reference to the terracotta army in the Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum in China. * The name Sadan could be a reference to the devil, Satan and his number 666. This could also explain why Sadan is the floor 6 boss in the Catacombs. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jul 22|version=none|Changed '''Terracotta''' [[Bestiary]] Bracket from {{Green|1}} to {{Green|2}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|611-1,097}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|1,527-2,742}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|100-200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,833-3,291}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|4,000-6,000}} to {{Dark Aqua|4,582-8,227}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.9.4|[[File:Sadan.png|26px]] Added '''Sadan'''.}} {{History|2023/September 12|Significantly sped up the Giant One's animation.}} {{History|0.27|Changed '''Terracotta''' [[Bestiary]] Bracket from {{Green|1}} to {{Green|2}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|611-1,097}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|1,527-2,742}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|100-200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,833-3,291}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|4,000-6,000}} to {{Dark Aqua|4,582-8,227}}.}} }}

His teacher said he will do "great things". |id = SCARF_1, MASTER_SCARF_1 }} '''Scarf''' is the {{MobCategory|Boss}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor II]] within [[The Catacombs]] [[Dungeon]]. == Collection == Killing Scarf increases the Scarf dungeon collection. {{CollectionTable|Scarf}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == The '''Scarf''' fight has two distinct phases. In the '''first phase''', '''Scarf''' is protected by a barrier (reversed world border), preventing players from attacking him. Players must defeat Scarf's Undeads, which include an {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}}, {{MobSprite|Undead Mage}}, {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}}, and {{MobSprite|Undead Archer}}. Each of the Undead works differently and use attacks or abilities corresponding to their role. In the '''second phase''', the barrier protecting '''Scarf''' disappears, and begins attacking players directly. All the Undead are also revived and become stronger. Scarf acts similar to the Warrior but uses many more abilities and is stronger. * It is recommended to kill the {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}} first in this phase, as he will heal Scarf if you do not kill him fast enough. === Attacks === '''Scarf''' and each mob will run towards the player to attack them. They also have additional, special attacks, as listed below: {|class="wikitable" ! Mob ! Attacks |- | Scarf | * {{AN|Skull Barrage}} - Scarf rises into the air, hovering slightly above the ground and barraging all players with explosive Wither Skeleton skulls. This move fires in a wide arc, causing many of the shots to miss or strike other players. Ghosts can tank the skulls from this ability. * {{AN|Soul Sand Blizzard}} - Scarf summons soul sand blocks in a path towards the player, dealing a percentage{{InfoNeeded}} of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}} to players who step in it. This also gives slowness and decreased FOV. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} | * {{AN|Charge}} - Occasionally charges at the player, dealing {{Red|0.3x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|864|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, or {{Red|1x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|54,000|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Archer}} | * {{AN|Arrow Barrage}} - Shoots a large number of arrows in all directions. * {{AN|Teleport}} - Teleport himself away from danger, or a player into danger (Usually Warrior's charge). * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the Warrior to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the archer, |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Mage}} | * {{AN|Wither Skulls}} - Shoots wither skulls towards the player while standing still, dealing {{Red|0.45x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,094.4|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.65x}} ({{Stat|Damage|29,640|icononly=yes}}) it in [[Master Mode]]. * {{AN|Magma Pit}} - Deals {{Red|0.15x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|364.8|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.6x}} ({{Stat|Damage|27,360|icononly=yes}}) it in [[Master Mode]]. * {{AN|Tsunami}} - Creates a wave that deals {{Red|0.25x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|608|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|22,800|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]].{{Cite Discord |url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1554515558685483030 |user = mrkeith |staff = yes |date = 9/29/26, 11:29 AM (EST) |text =
how is the damage for the undead mage (scarf fight)'s tsunami calculated?
Base scarf mage damage is 2432
Master scarf mage damage is 45600 Tsunami damage multiplier is 0.25x for normal, 0.5x for master }} * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the mage. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}} | * {{AN|Heal}} - Heals up itself and nearby Undeads. * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the priest. |} === Summoned Mobs === {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Undead Warrior}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Archer}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Mage}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Priest}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * Scarf has {{Hp|375M}} and his Undeads have significantly more {{Hp}}. His attacks deal much more damage. * In both phases, 2 of each type of Undead spawn instead of 1. * In the 2nd phase, Scarf gains damage resistance based on how many Undeads are alive. He will be completely immune to damage until at least 4 undeads are defeated. == Drops == Killing Scarf directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 286-855 |coins = 715-2,137 |combat_xp = 2,145-6,412 |orbs = 858-2,565 }} Defeating him will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor II/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor II/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 286 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor II]] |health = 1,000,000 |damage = 3,456 |coins = 715 |combat_xp = 2,145 |orbs = 858 |id = SCARF_1 |level2 = 855 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor II|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor II]] |health2 = 375,000,000 |damage2 = 81,000 |coins2 = 2,137 |combat_xp2 = 6,412 |orbs2 = 2,565 |id2 = MASTER_SCARF_1 }} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Scarf}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those Crypts. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: If you can beat my Undeads, I'll personally grant you the privilege to replace them. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: ARISE, MY CREATIONS! &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: This should be interesting. }} |- | class="ct" | Start of Phase 2 | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Those toys are not strong enough I see. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Don't get too excited though. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Did you forget? I'll take you myself!}} |- | class="ct" | After dealing major damage to {{MobSprite|Scarf}} | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] Scarf&f: That was nothing my Priest can't heal!}} |- | class="ct" | If the players have lost | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: I always knew I would win...I'm a genius. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: But don't worry I'll add you to my collection. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: In a way, you'll live forever... }} |- | class="ct" | If the players have won | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Whatever... &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: You'll never beat my teacher.. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: His technique.. is too advanced.. }} |- |} == Trivia == * A reason Scarf was the top student in his class was that he hoped he could bring his mother back. This is suggested by the [[Red Scarf]] reforge stone, as his mother knit him that Scarf. * One of Scarf's dialogue lines is "''Yare yare daze''"; this is a reference to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. * Another of Scarf's dialogue lines is "''Necro no Jutsu!''"; this is a reference to Naruto. * Another is "''If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win.''" which is most likely a reference to Attack on Titan. * The [[Adaptive Blade]], a drop from Scarf, is a reference that Scarf and all his Undead represent all the classes players can choose from, with Scarf being the [[Tank]]. * Scarf is revived by [[The Watcher]] on [[The Catacombs - Floor 4|Floor 4]] , [[The Catacombs - Floor V|5]] , [[The Catacombs - Floor VI|6]] only having Scarf in his Second phase. * When Scarf summoned as Undead is defeated, it doesn't add to the collection. * The Undead Warrior(s) is/are currently bugged to charge up {{stat|True Damage}} instead of regular Damage.{{Confirm}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|3,870|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|3,456|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|90,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|81,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|286-855}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|715-2,137}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|858-2,565}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|300-450}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,145-6,412}}.}} |beta= {{History|2020/July 7|[[File:Scarf.png|26px]] Added '''Scarf'''.}} {{History|0.26.1|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|3,870|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|3,456|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|90,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|81,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|286-855}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|715-2,137}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|858-2,565}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|300-450}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,145-6,412}}.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Dungeons]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Catacombs]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]

{{Game Update}} {{Infobox/Mob |tab = Phase 1 and 2 |image = The Professor.png |category = Boss |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 3,000,000-600,000,000 |damage = 5,976-135,000 }} |mob_type = *{{Mt|Humanoid}} *{{Mt|Arcane}} |mob_level = 362-940 |description = {{Gray|Professor}}
Despite his great technique, he failed the Masters exam three times. Works from 8 to 5. Cares about his students. |id = PROFESSOR_1, MASTER_PROFESSOR_1 |tab2 = Phase 3 |image2 = Elder Guardian.gif |category2 = Boss |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] |stats2 = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 3,000,000-600,000,000 |damage = 5,976-135,000 }} |mob_type2 = *{{Mt|Aquatic}} *{{Mt|Arcane}} |mob_level2 = 362-940 |description2 = {{Gray|Professor}}
Despite his great technique, he failed the Masters exam three times. Works from 8 to 5. Cares about his students. |id2 = PROFESSOR_1, MASTER_PROFESSOR_1 }} '''The Professor''' is the {{MobCategory|Boss}} of [[Catacombs - Floor III]] of [[The Catacombs]]. == Collection == Killing the Professor increases '''The Professor''' collection. {{CollectionTable|The Professor}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Phases === '''The Professor''' fight has three distinct phases: {|class="wikitable" ! Phase ! Description |- | First | In the first phase, the Professor is surrounded by a barrier at the beginning of the fight, preventing players from dealing damage through it. To end the first phase, all of The Professor's Guardians must be defeated. Each guardian has a special attack/ability. The Guardians are revived with {{Green|80%}} (Normal) / {{Green|90%}} ([[Master Mode]]) {{Stat|health}} after 10 seconds (7 in [[Master Mode]]) of being killed. |- | Second | In the second phase, all four guardians are dead, and the player must fight the Professor until they reach {{Red|25%}} of their {{Stat|Health}}, or {{HP|750,000}} and {{HP|150,000,000}} in [[Master Mode]]. |- | Third | In his third phase, the Professor absorbs the dead guardians and transforms into a Guardian himself. He will spawn {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s, and occasionally use the {{AN|Giga Heal}}, {{AN|TNT Rain}}, and {{AN|Focus Laser}} abilities. If the fight goes on for too long, the arena will flood but spawn in several boats. Once the Professor is defeated, Necron will smite him with lightning and warn the players not to go further before he deals with them himself. |} === Attacks === Below are a list of attacks of each mob. More details about the guardian's attacks can be seen on their respective pages. ==== The Professor ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Attack ! Allowed Phases ! Description |- | Melee | Second | The Professor has a melee attack, dealing damage to players he strikes. |- | {{AN|Prismarine Blizzard}} | Second | The Professor summons prismarine blocks in a path towards the player, dealing {{Red|5%}} ({{Red|15%}} in [[Master Mode]]) of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}}. |- | Laser | Third | The Professor will fire a laser at the player, attacking every {{Green|0.75 seconds}} using its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|TNT Rain}} | Third | The Professor flings TNT around him in all directions, which detonate and deal its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|Giga Heal}} | Third | The Professor begins a countdown. At the end of this countdown, he and all the {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s in the room are healed fully. |} ==== {{MobSprite|Chaos Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | {{AN|Discharge}} | The Chaos Guardian has an {{Red|Anger Level}} above its head, which is indicated by the amount of {{Yellow|⚡ lightning icons}} it has. Hitting the guardian enough times will increase the level, up to level 6. Every two seconds, the Chaos Guardian will strike lightning around itself, damaging players who are nearby. This deals {{Red|0.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode, or {{Red|0.7x}} it in [[Master Mode]], multiplied by the {{Red|Anger Level}}. Upon reaching {{Red|Anger Level}} 6, the level will reset down to 1, and the guardian will prepare to '''overcharge'''. Several seconds later, lightning will rapidly strike in the surrounding area for several seconds, dealing the amount of {{Stat|Damage}} equivalent to an {{Red|Anger Level}} or 12, or {{Stat|Damage|17,280|icononly=yes}} in normal mode and {{Stat|Damage|453,600}} in [[Master Mode]]. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|5,760|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|324,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Healthy Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | {{AN|Giga Heal}} | The Healthy Guardian will announce that a {{AN|Giga Heal}} is about to occur, which will heal all of the alive guardians in 10 seconds (8 in [[Master Mode]]). During this time, attacking the Healthy Guardian will reduce the healed amount by {{Red|5%}} per hit. Hitting 20 times will stop all healing from occurring. The base amount healed is {{Stat|Health|10,000,000}}, or {{Stat|Health|210,000,000}} in [[Master Mode]]. Upon healing, the next announcement will occur 60 seconds later (45s in [[Master Mode]]). |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|8,784|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Reinforced Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | Higher {{Stat|Health}} | The Reinforced Guardian has higher {{Stat|Health}} compared to the other guardians. |- | {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s | The Reinforced Guardian will repeatedly spawn {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s around itself in the air. These will fly around, firing lasers at any nearby players. After being alive for some time, they will turn into Elder Rogue Guardians, which have higher [[Stats]]. |- | {{AN|TNT Rain}} | Every ~40 seconds (or ~30s in [[Master Mode]]), the Reinforced Guardian will start throwing TNT around itself for 10 seconds. This TNT deals {{Red|0.6x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|3,024|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|0.8x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|64,800|icononly=yes}}). This timer runs independently of the Reinforged Guardian's alive state, meaning killing it does not impact this timer. If the TNT rain were to start when the boss is otherwise dead, it gets skipped. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|10,080|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Laser Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | Default Laser | By default, the Laser Guardian will fire a standard, slower laser at the player, attacking every {{Green|0.75 seconds}} using its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|Focus Beam}} | Starting 10s into the fight, the Laser Guardian will begin the following looping process: * Announce that the {{AN|Focus Beam}} is being charged up. This disables the default laser, and takes {{Green|15s}} in normal mode or 10 seconds in [[Master Mode]]. * Start firing the higher powered {{AN|Focus Beam}} instead of the default laser. This attacks at a faster {{Green|0.5s}} rate and has a higher reach, but only deals {{Red|0.1x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|432|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|0.6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|48,600|icononly=yes}}). This laser lasts for {{Green|60s}} in normal mode and {{Green|45s}} in [[Master Mode]]. * Announce that the {{AN|Focus Beam}} has overheated and is on cooldown, which lasts for {{Green|10s}}. * Repeat this process. If the Laser Guardian dies, once it respawns, the same cooldown message is sent {{Green|5s}} after, meaning the laser starts building up {{Green|15s}} later. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|8,640|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} === Guardians === {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Chaos Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Healthy Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Reinforced Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Laser Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Rogue Guardian}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * The Professor has {{Hp|600M}} and his guardians {{Hp|120M}} and {{Hp|140M}}. All attacks deal more {{Stat|Damage}}. * {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s immediately spawn as the Elder variant. * Guardians are revived after 7 seconds instead of 10. * When Guardians are revived, they regain {{Green|90%}} of their {{Stat|health}} instead of {{Green|80%}}. * The {{MobSprite|Healthy Guardian}} is invulnerable when performing {{AN|Giga Heal}}, however, {{AN|Giga Heal}} can still be interrupted by hitting the Guardian enough times. == Drops == Killing the Professor directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 362-940 |coins = 905-2,350 |combat_xp = 2,715-7,050 |orbs = 1,086-2,820 }} Defeating him in the third phase will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor III/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor III/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 362 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] |health = 3,000,000 |damage = 5,976 |coins = 905 |combat_xp = 2,715 |orbs = 1,086 |id = PROFESSOR_1 |level2 = 940 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor III|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor III]] |health2 = 600,000,000 |damage2 = 135,000 |coins2 = 2,350 |combat_xp2 = 7,050 |orbs2 = 2,820 |id2 = MASTER_PROFESSOR_1 }} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#The Professor}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I was burdened with terrible news recently... &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My most talented student... &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I'll show you real power! }} |- | class="ct" | One guardian dead | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: You took one of them down, but that won't be enough! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I'm afraid I can quickly revive any one of my Guardians! }} |- | class="ct" | Two guardians dead | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My barrier is weakening, but it still holds strong! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Two Guardians, impressive... }} |- | class="ct" | Three guardians dead | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: What?! Nobody has managed to take three of my Guardians down before! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My Guardians! }} |- | class="ct" | While using Revive | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Revive, (name)! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My technique is much more advanced than Scarf's.. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My barrier will hold as long as my Guardians are alive. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Give up Adventurers, it only takes me a few seconds to revive my guardians. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I can do this all day. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Perfect offense and defense, I am INVINCIBLE! }} |- | class="ct" | While using Volley | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: No more hiding! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Dodge this! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Here! Catch! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Here's a curveball for you! }} |- | class="ct" | Start of Phase 2 | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Oh? You found my Guardians' one weakness? &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Even if you took my barrier down, I can still fight. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: This time I'll be your opponent! }} |- | class="ct" | After dealing major damage to {{NPCSprite|The Professor}} | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] The Professor&f: These wounds are nothing for my Giga Heal!}} |- | class="ct" | While using TNT Rain | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] The Professor&f: How do you like the taste of Gunpowder?}} |- | class="ct" | After successfully using Giga Heal | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!}} |- | class="ct" | Start of Phase 3 | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: These Guardians aren't just for show I'm afraid! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: The process is irreversible, but I'll be stronger than a Wither now! }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have lost | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I give you an F-! }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have won | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: What?! My Guardian power is unbeatable! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: How could you... I needed more power... &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m- &4[BOSS] Necron&c: That is enough, fool! &4[BOSS] Necron&c: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with... &4[BOSS] Necron&c: Before I have to deal with you myself. }} |- | class="ct" | Idle | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My Guardians! Show them your power!}} |- |} == Trivia == * The Floor III boss was called Oak in the Alpha Hypixel Network.https://ibb.co/NCQp6f3https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3C3seezNuYg&t=12 ** This was a reference to Professor Oak from the ''Pokémon'' franchise. ** It is unknown why it was changed. * This is the first usage of Elder Guardians in Hypixel SkyBlock. * This is the first time [[Necron]] interacts with the player. *[[Necron]] killed The Professor after he was defeated. * The Professor canonically taught Scarf the Necromancy skills they have; however, he also has other unknown students. * The Rogue Guardians can be absorbed by Necromancer Sword and Reaper Scythe, making them the only non-undead mob to be able to be summoned. * His head has the same texture as [[Sadan]]'s, except that it has been recolored and the brows are missing. *Although the professor is the one who drops [[Adaptive Armor]], the armor is upgraded with [[Scarf Fragment]]s. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|6,640|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|5,976|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|150,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|135,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|362-940}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|905-2,350}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,086-2,820}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|400-600}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,715-7,050}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.8|[[File:The Professor.png|26px]] Added '''The Professor'''.}} {{History|0.26.1|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|6,640|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|5,976|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|150,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|135,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|362-940}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|905-2,350}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,086-2,820}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|400-600}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,715-7,050}}.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Catacombs]] [[Category:Dungeons]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]

{{Infobox/Dungeon enemy |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 4-6 }} |category = Boss |mob_type = *{{mt|Cubic}} *{{mt|Arcane}} |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]] |special_behavior = Summons Spirit Animals |mob_level = 1 |description = {{gray|Shaman Necromancer}}
Powerful Necromancer who specializes in animals. Calls himself a vegetarian, go figure. |id = THORN_1, MASTER_THORN_1 }} {{For|the Enchantment {{Ench|Thorns}}|Thorns}} '''Thorn '''is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]]. He is a ghast which spawns animals and can only be damaged by his Spirit Bow. Thorn's remains re-appear on [[The Catacombs - Floor V|Floor V]], from which [[Livid]] drains energy in order to clone himself. == Collection == Killing Thorn increases the Thorn collection. {{CollectionTable|Thorn}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === Unlike most of the other bosses in The Catacombs, Thorn only has one apparent phase, same as Livid, however technically has different phases, but the differences are minuscule. Thorn will speed up the more he has been damaged and when he is about to die in one more hit, Thorn will start turning around, making it harder to hit him. Additionally, with each wave that comes, the Spirit Animals gain more HP, overall making it a longer fight. After {{Green|15s}} of dialogue, Thorn will summon Spirit Animals which can deal damage to the player along with a new {{mcat|miniboss}} called the Spirit Bear. A counter (indicated by a ring of [[Sea Lantern]]s and [[Block of Coal|Coal Blocks]] near the audience) shows how many Spirit Animals have been killed. When the ring fully lights up with Sea Lanterns, the Spirit Bear will spawn. There is a crowd of enemies cheering for Thorn in the arena. While they can't attack the player, they can give helpful hints for Thorn's attacks. Although, if the player enters the crowds viewing area, swarms of spirit bats will attack the player and deal large quantities of damage. Occasionally, one of the circles in the arena will change color, either green or orange. If it turns green, it will ready up a Healing Circle much like the Healer's one, but if it turns orange, it will start a fire on that circle. Thorn's spirit animals will take 5% of their HP every second they are in the fire. === Spirit Bear === The Spirit Bear is a {{mcat|mb}} summoned during the fight. It will be summoned once 25 Spirit Animals (or 30 in Master Mode) have been killed. It has {{hp|5M}} (or {{hp|180M}} in Master Mode) and can attack players with a Golden Sword or a Spirit Bow. The spirit bear will heal overtime, but very slowly. When the Spirit Bear is killed, it drops a Spirit Bow. The player who picks it up only gets one chance to shoot Thorn. Each successful hit stuns Thorn for {{Green|5s}}, followed by a {{Green|1s}} cooldown before Thorn can be damaged again. Every hit from the Spirit Bow removes {{hp|1}} from Thorn’s health. Once Thorn’s health reaches zero, they die. === Summoned Mobs === Throughout the fight, various Spirit Mobs will spawn in. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bull}} - These rush towards the player to attack them. They also have a charge attack, dealing {{Red|30%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in regular mode ({{Stat|Damage|846.6|icononly=yes}}) and {{Red|75%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|53,550|icononly=yes}}). * {{MobSprite|Spirit Wolf}} - These will swarm players and attack them in large quantities. They deal {{Red|3.5x}} damage to players using the [[Tank]] [[Class]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bat}} - These will swarm players who are in the air. They do not respect player invincibility frames. This means if a player jumps in the air and is swarmed by bats, they will be mowed to death in seconds. Can be deterred by decoys as they have no vanilla attacking ability and cannot destroy it. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Rabbit}} - These will attack the player, launching them in the air, and then run away. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Chicken}} - These slowly descends to the ground, strike nearby players with lightning. If it touches the ground, it will turn into a Chicken Mine. Players who walk over it take damage and are knocked into the air. The lightning attacks deal {{Red|1.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,392|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, and {{Red|0.35x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|9,408|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Sheep}} - These run toward the player and explodes like a creeper. This deals up to {{Red|0.2x}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}}, or {{Stat|Damage|3,808|icononly=yes}} in regular mode and {{Stat|Damage|133,280|icononly=yes}} in [[Master Mode]], with the amount depending on close the player was to the explosion.{{Confirm}} {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bear}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bull}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Wolf}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bat}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Rabbit}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Chicken}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Sheep}} }} == Drops == Killing Thorn will complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Master Mode Loot}} == Dialogue == === Thorn === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Welcome Adventurers! I am Thorn, the Spirit! And host of the Vegan Trials! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Today you'll be our spectacle. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Dance! Dance with my Spirit animals! And may you perish in a delightful way! }} |- | class="ct" | Attempting to attack {{MobSprite|Thorn}} without using a {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I'm already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - I am Thorn the Spirit! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I love your fighting spirit, but I am immune to your tricks! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Trying to damage me like that...desperate... }} |- | class="ct" | After being damaged with a {{Item|Spirit Bow}} | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: I feel...dizzy... &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: It hurts...what a delicate feeling... &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Round and round, another wound. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: My energy, it goes away... }} |- | class="ct" | Spawning a wave | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate! }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have lost | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Wonderful performance humans, truly beautiful. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece. &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep! &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken! }} |- | class="ct" | If all players have won | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: This is it...where shall I go now? &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain... &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Congratulations humans, you may pass. }} |- |} === Crowd === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro | {{Dialogue| &bCROWD&f: Alright here we go Thorn! Drop some spirits on these fools! &bCROWD&f: Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo &bCROWD&f: Let's go Thorn! They don't stand a chance! &bCROWD&f: Thorn is preparing his attacks! What an amazing spirit! &bCROWD&f: Vegans! Yeahhh!!! Now let's exploit some animals for personal gain! Woo woo! &bCROWD&f: Here we go Thorn! You can't just beat Thorn! &bCROWD&f: Pack it up boys...nothing to see here... &bCROWD&f: Another 2020 catastrophe. &bCROWD&f: OOF }} |- |} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Thorn}} == Trivia == *The [[Spirit Bow]] used in the Thorn fight has some extra lore attached to it. {{Slot|Spirit Bow}} *Thorn's remains are seen in during the [[Livid]] boss fight in the form of a purple orb (|''This Orb you see, is Thorn, or what is left of him.''"). *The Spirit Bow specifically does approximately {{stat|dmg|75,000}} per hit against Thorn. *One of '''Thorn''''s lines is "Round and round, another wound." which might have been intended to rhyme, even though it does not. *The dialogue of '''Thorn's''' crowd contains many references. **"''Another 2020 catastrophe.''" references the [[w:COVID-19|COVID-19 pandemic]]. **"''Killing a spirit...what kind of man does that? ... No man at all.''" references ''Breaking Bad'', in which Gustavo Fring asks Hector Salamanca "''What kind of man talks to the DEA? No man, no man at all.''" **"''Avenge Bonzo! #RememberBonzo''" and "''Remember Bonzo! #NeverForget''" references {{MobSprite|Bonzo}}, the boss of [[The Catacombs - Floor I]], hinting that the two are connected. Notably, Bonzo is a circus clown and Thorn hosts a performance. **"''My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.''" references the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/my-disappointment-is-immeasurable-and-my-day-is-ruined quote of the same name], in which host of TheReportOfTheWeek, Reviewbrah, says the exact quote after tasting Popeyes' cheddar biscuit butterfly shrimp. **''"Fs in the chat!''" is a reference to the meme [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/press-f-to-pay-respects originating from 2014's Call of Duty Advanced Wafare], where there is an event in the campaign where you have to "Press F to pay respects", which eventually has been used by gamers in the event of a huge loss. ==Tips== *There is currently a bug that allows players can stun '''Thorn''' in place using a {{Item|Tribal Spear}} or {{Item|Bonemerang}}. This is commonly used by players to make the bossfight easier. **Attempting to stun '''Thorn''' but failing the stun whilst Thorn is still alive will make '''Thorn''' will become extremely fast. This is because when '''Thorn''' gets hit with the [[Tribal Spear]] or [[Bonemerang]] it treats it like he got hit with the [[Spirit Bow (Thorn)|Spirit Bow]] which increases his speed. **The {{Item|Terminator}}'s "{{an|Salvation}}" ability can also cause him to reach this state but it is much more difficult, since the ability can only be cast after landing {{green|3}} hits with the bow. == Gallery == Thorn Orb.png|'''Thorn'''{{'}}s remains during the [[Livid]] boss fight == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/July 30|[[File:Thorn.png|26px]] Added '''Thorn'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]
